name: GoodTask
description: GoodTask is a task manager for Apple devices that presents Reminders and Calendar data together with smart lists, boards, filters, quick actions, subtasks, repeat-after-completion, and planning views.
agentUseSummary: GoodTask cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because it reads Apple Reminders and Calendar stores directly and its supported URL scheme and Shortcuts execute through an installed app, while GoodTask provides no open account API and Relay Marketplace does not currently ship that separate device-local authority.

blocked.label: Connect GoodTask
blocked.description: Relay does not present Apple, iCloud, Google, Exchange, calendar, subscription, or installed-app state as a Railway API connection and does not silently substitute a device-local authority.

blocked.label: Use GoodTask automation
blocked.description: GoodTask's URL scheme, callback URLs, App Shortcuts, quick actions, and task links require an installed Mac, iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch app and local Reminders and Calendar permissions that Relay cannot currently mount.

blocked.label: Access GoodTask data
blocked.description: Relay does not request Apple or connected-account credentials, inspect EventKit or local app state, automate app UI, call private synchronization services, or infer provider authority from Reminders and Calendar access.

blocked.label: Change tasks or events
blocked.description: Searching, reading, creating, editing, completing, moving, duplicating, deleting, or running quick actions on tasks, lists, subtasks, reminders, and calendar events remains unavailable until Relay ships explicit local execution and approval boundaries.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Relay ships a separately disclosed, user-authorized device-local GoodTask connector using supported Apple automation and data permissions.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay does not silently bridge OpenClaw to GoodTask, Apple Reminders, Calendar, App Shortcuts, callback URLs, or other device-local authority.
Relay does not silently bridge Hermes to GoodTask, Apple Reminders, Calendar, App Shortcuts, callback URLs, or other device-local authority.

providerSetup.blocker: GoodTask states that it fetches tasks and events directly from the Apple Reminders and Calendar apps, uses iCloud Drive only to synchronize settings, and has no open app API. Its supported URL scheme and App Shortcuts can query and mutate tasks but execute on a configured Apple device with local app and data permissions. Relay's current Marketplace runtime intentionally excludes local-app command execution and cannot truthfully expose that authority from Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Apple, iCloud, Google, Exchange, calendar, subscription, or app credentials; inspect local Reminders, Calendar, or GoodTask state; automate the app; or show Connect. Reconsider after Relay ships a separately disclosed Apple-device local-connection architecture with app presence, explicit Reminders and Calendar permissions, pinned reviewed operations, per-action approval, result redaction, audit, and no cloud fallback.

evidence.supports: GoodTask states that it displays and edits the device's Apple Reminders and Calendar data, including data from accounts linked to those Apple apps, while some GoodTask-only properties remain local.
GoodTask documents a device-local URL and callback scheme for opening views and tasks and creating tasks with dates, alerts, locations, notes, priorities, and subtasks through the installed app.
GoodTask documents App Shortcuts on iOS and Mac for querying, creating, editing, deleting, and running quick actions on tasks.
GoodTask states that it does not use CloudKit for task data, fetches Reminders and Calendar data directly, and uses iCloud Drive sync only for settings.
GoodTask explicitly states that the app has no open API for sharing GoodTask-only information.
GoodTask says it stores no personal data and that data used by synchronization services remains private to users and connects directly between those services and users.
